correctness.rationale: The actual RESULT.md proves sum g_i=(n-2)e2=0 and Euler F∈J. The identity g_i+g_j=(x_i+x_j)(T+x_i+x_j) bounds nonzero common zeros to at most two coordinate values; parity of binomial coefficients for n=4m reduces each projective support to an indicator of cardinality s≡1 mod4. The n-1 generators have height n-1, forming a regular sequence, and the projective degree is 2^(n-1). For every Q_S, the pair-value substitution sends each gradient to 0 modulo v², proving J⊂∩Q_S. The 2^(n-2) disjoint projective Q_S each have length 2, giving equal degree. Both are saturated, so equality of projective schemes lifts to equality of homogeneous ideals. The argument covers n=4 and all algebraically closed fields of characteristic exactly 2; no analytic singularity type is asserted.
